settings.title: Settings
settings.languageHint: This only changes the interface. Content, voice and subtitle languages are chosen separately in each studio.
settings.lowEndHint: Turns off animations and transitions to keep the interface responsive on older computers.
settings.keysNote: API keys are stored in the Windows Credential Manager, never in the app database.
settings.cleanBody: {{count}} files that no project, history entry or profile uses will be permanently deleted.
settings.autoUpdateHint: Contacts GitHub once at launch to see whether a newer build exists. Nothing is installed without your click.
settings.updateAvailableToast: A newer build ({{build}}) is available. Open Settings to install it.
settings.devBuild: This copy was not built by the release workflow, so it has no build number and cannot check for updates.
settings.updateSecurity: Installers come from this project's GitHub Releases and are checked against a SHA-256 checksum before they run. The app closes when the installer starts.
settings.ffmpegHint: Optional. Lets Kothok compress and split recordings larger than 25 MB for transcription. Downloads about 100 MB from gyan.dev and checks its SHA-256.

errors.no_model: No model is selected for this provider.

errors.network_error: Could not reach the provider. Check your internet connection.

errors.needs_confirmation: This provider may charge money. Please confirm to continue.

api.title: API Manager
api.subtitle: Connect your own AI providers. Keys are stored in Windows Credential Manager, never in the app database.
api.scopeNote: Text, image, voice and transcription providers work now.
api.emptyHint: Add Gemini, OpenRouter, a local model server or any OpenAI-compatible API to start generating content.
api.name: Display name
api.endpointHint: Must start with https://, or http://localhost for a server on this PC.
api.apiKeyKeep: A key is saved. Leave blank to keep it.
api.apiKeyOptional: Optional for servers running on this PC.
api.deleteBody: “{{name}}” and its saved key will be removed from this computer.
api.fallbackHint: If the main provider fails, these are tried in order. Providers marked paid always ask for your confirmation first.
api.fallbackPaidNote: Paid providers in this chain are never used without asking you first.

gemini.name: Google Gemini
gemini.note: Has a free tier — limits and availability change, so check Google AI Studio for current quotas.

openrouter.name: OpenRouter
openrouter.note: Models whose id ends in :free cost nothing; other models bill your OpenRouter credit.

groq.name: Groq
groq.note: Offers a free tier with rate limits — check Groq's current terms.

ollama.name: Ollama (local)
ollama.note: Runs on this PC. Start Ollama first.

lmstudio.name: LM Studio (local)
lmstudio.note: Runs on this PC. Start its local server first.

custom.name: Custom (OpenAI-compatible)
custom.note: Any server that speaks the OpenAI chat API.

gemini_image.name: Google Gemini (images)
gemini_image.note: Image models may require a paid plan — check Google's pricing. Enter the image model id from Google's documentation (for example gemini-3.1-flash-image).

openai_images.name: OpenAI (images)
openai_images.note: Paid API, billed per image. Enter an image model id from OpenAI's documentation.

custom_image.name: Custom (OpenAI-compatible images)
custom_image.note: Any server that implements /images/generations, including servers running on this PC.

google_tts.name: Google Cloud Text-to-Speech
google_tts.note: Needs a Google Cloud project with billing enabled and the Text-to-Speech API turned on. Bangla: Gemini-TTS supports bn-BD (save a Gemini-TTS model id); standard voices are bn-IN. Check Google's pricing.

openai_tts.name: OpenAI (speech)
openai_tts.note: Paid API. Save a speech model id from OpenAI's documentation and type a voice name in Voice Studio.

custom_tts.name: Custom (OpenAI-compatible speech)
custom_tts.note: Any server that implements /audio/speech, including servers running on this PC.

groq_stt.name: Groq (Whisper)
groq_stt.note: Whisper models, free tier with rate limits and a 25 MB upload limit. Save a model id such as whisper-large-v3-turbo (check Groq's model list).

openai_stt.name: OpenAI (transcription)
openai_stt.note: Paid API, billed per audio minute. Save a transcription model id from OpenAI's documentation.

local_stt.name: Local Whisper server
local_stt.note: A Whisper server on this PC that copies the OpenAI /audio/transcriptions API. Adjust the address and port to match your server.

gemini_tts.name: Google Gemini (speech)
gemini_tts.note: Uses your Gemini API key. Pick a Gemini text-to-speech model; voices are Gemini's prebuilt voices and Bangla is detected from the text.

gemini_stt.name: Google Gemini (transcription)
gemini_stt.note: Uses your Gemini API key to transcribe audio. Returns text without timestamps; files over about 14 MB need FFmpeg.

api.shareTitle: Use this key for other jobs
api.shareHint: One key can serve every page. Tick a job and Kothok connects it, syncs the models and picks a starting one — you can change the model on each page.

content.needTopic: Write a topic or request first.
content.stopped: Stopped. The result will be discarded.
content.topicPlaceholder: What should the content be about?
content.fallback: Try fallback providers if this one fails
content.noProviderTitle: Set up an AI provider first
content.noProviderBody: Open API Manager, add a provider, enter your key and save a model.
content.editorPlaceholder: Generated text appears here. You can also write or paste your own text, then use the tools above on the whole text or on a selection.
content.usedFallback: The main provider failed — answered by {{provider}} ({{model}})
content.confirmPaidBody: “{{name}}” is marked as paid. Use it for this request?

projects.emptyHint: Save content from Content Studio to create your first project, or create an empty one on the left.
projects.noItems: This project has no items yet.
projects.nothingToExport: There is no text content in this project to export.
projects.deleteBody: “{{name}}” and everything saved in it will be deleted.
projects.deleteItemBody: “{{name}}” will be deleted from this project.

thumb.sizeRange: Width and height must be between 100 and 4096 pixels.
thumb.badImage: This image could not be opened. Use PNG, JPG, WEBP or GIF.
thumb.needPrompt: Write or generate a prompt first.
thumb.noImageProvider: No image provider is set up
thumb.noImageProviderBody: Add an image provider in API Manager and save a model. Image generation may cost money depending on the provider. You can still design thumbnails manually without it.
thumb.promptHint: Tip: generated images should not contain text — add your text as a layer so Bangla letters stay correct.
thumb.paidNote: This provider is marked as paid — each image may be billed to your account.
thumb.noLayers: Add text or an image to start. Drag layers on the canvas; use the corner handle to resize.

voice.noProvider: No voice provider is set up
voice.noProviderBody: Add a voice provider in API Manager. Speech generation uses an online service and may cost money depending on the provider.
voice.textPlaceholder: Type or paste the script here…
voice.voiceHintGoogle: {{count}} voices returned by the provider for this language.
voice.voiceHintManual: This provider has no voice list. Type a voice name from its documentation.
voice.modelHintGoogle: Leave empty for standard voices. For Gemini-TTS enter the model id from Google's documentation.
voice.geminiNote: Speed and pitch apply to standard voices only; they are ignored when a Gemini-TTS model is set.
voice.paidNote: This provider is marked as paid — each generation may be billed to your account.
voice.needVoice: Choose or type a voice first.
voice.chunks: Long text was generated in {{count}} parts and joined.
voice.geminiApiNote: Gemini speech detects the language from the text; speed and pitch are not available. Output is WAV.

vlib.noList: This provider does not publish a voice list. Type its voice name directly in Voice Studio.
vlib.previewPaid: Preview generates a short clip with this provider and may be billed.
vlib.cloneNote: Profiles store a consented voice sample. No voice-cloning engine is connected yet, so profiles cannot generate speech in this version.
vlib.deleteBody: “{{name}}” and its stored sample will be removed.
vlib.sampleHint: WAV, MP3, M4A, FLAC or OGG. Only use a voice you own or have written permission to use.
vlib.statementHint: e.g. who the voice belongs to and that they allow this use (at least 10 characters).
vlib.consent: I confirm this voice is mine or I have the speaker's explicit permission to use it.

audio.noProvider: No transcription provider is set up
audio.noProviderBody: Add a transcription provider in API Manager (for example Groq's free tier). The audio file is uploaded to that provider.
audio.limits: Files up to 25 MB are uploaded as they are. Larger recordings (up to 2 GB) need FFmpeg (Settings → Tools); they are compressed and split into 10-minute parts automatically.
audio.modelPlaceholder: Save a model in API Manager
audio.paidNote: This provider is marked as paid — transcription may be billed to your account.
audio.noSpeakers: Speaker detection is not supported in this version.
audio.copyFailed: Could not copy to the clipboard.
audio.noTiming: This model returned text without timestamps, so subtitle export is not available.
audio.bigFile: Large file: it will be compressed with FFmpeg before upload, and is not loaded into the player.

subs.noCues: No subtitle cues were found in that file.
subs.emptyHint: Open an SRT or VTT file, transcribe audio first, or start from a blank track.
subs.splitHint: Click inside the text where to split, then press this

model.notListed: This model is not in the provider's list for this job — it may be meant for something else. Choose one from the list.
